# Advanced Insulation & Fabrications (AISMF)

> Brisbane-based commercial and industrial insulation specialist offering custom fabrication, thermal management, and fire protection solutions.

AISMF provides comprehensive insulation and sheet metal fabrication services to mining, oil/gas, manufacturing, and commercial sectors across Australia. With 20+ years of experience based in Acacia Ridge, Queensland, the company specializes in pre-insulated pipework, spray foam, pipe lagging, and passive fire protection systems.

## Key Topics

- Commercial insulation
- Industrial insulation
- Pipe insulation & lagging
- Polyurethane spray foam
- Passive fire protection
- Pre-insulated pipework
- Sheet metal fabrication
- Thermal management
- Energy efficiency
- Fire protection systems
- Insulation covers
- Brisbane-based services
- Mining & oil/gas sector
- WHS compliance

- [Pre-insulated Pipes - Advanced Insulation & Fabrications](https://www.aismf.com.au/pre-insulated-pipework): Pre-insulated pipework products for thermal efficiency & temperature control

## Specialized Solutions

- [Polyurethane Spray Foam Insulation - AISMF](https://www.aismf.com.au/polyurethane-spray-foam): Polyurethane spray foam insulation for industrial buildings & weatherproofing
- [Fire Insulation & Passive Fire Protection - AISMF](https://www.aismf.com.au/passive-fire-protection): Passive fire protection products resisting high temps & toxic smoke
- [Pipe Insulation Covers - Advanced Insulation & Fabrications](https://www.aismf.com.au/insulation-covers): Custom pipe insulation covers for thermal management & personnel safety
